goal_claim_rule: NEVER CLAIMABLE: this Goal is a planning container only. Builders claim one contained sub-goal.

boundary_rules: Integration Ecosystem owns connector security/permission integrity, capability compatibility, runtime reliability/recovery, cross-system technical workflow integration and developer certification.

Connected business-domain Managers retain authority for Sales, Finance, Customer Experience, Service Delivery, Supply, Field and other domain outcomes; connector authority never becomes business-domain authority.
Titan Prime retains strategic orchestration; Cross-System Integration Orchestrator coordinates integration dependencies/handoffs and exposes trade-offs without replacing Prime.
Providers, APIs, channels, plugins, model connectors, SaaS systems, SDKs, adapters and marketplaces are tools/resources, not workforce identities.
Raw secrets remain behind Titan Locker/approved credential boundaries; connector workers receive only governed references/tokens/scopes needed for the bounded action.
Every external side effect must be scoped, correlated/idempotent where applicable and receipt-backed; ambiguous external state remains explicit until reconciled.

agent_goal_rule: This goal owns durable business/domain outcomes and may reuse, extend or create canonical workforce identities subject to non-duplication and outcome-owner tests.
workforce_goal_rule: Agents are permitted only for durable business/operational outcomes with a distinct ownership boundary. Reuse or extend canonical identities before creating new ones.
